title: Meeting the Periodic Table
summary: How Mendeleev organised the elements, what groups and periods mean, and where metals and non-metals sit, for the first 20 elements.

ib.note: Periodic trends are developed in MYP 4

cbse.chapter: Chemistry Part I Ch 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties (removed from Class 10 in the rationalised syllabus)
Exploration (2026) Ch 8: Journey Inside the Atom (electron arrangement)

objectives: I can describe how the periodic table is arranged by atomic number into groups and periods.
I can locate metals, non-metals and metalloids on the table.
I can link group number to outer electrons and period number to electron shells.
I can explain how Mendeleev used the table to predict undiscovered elements.
misconceptions: The table is arranged in alphabetical order or by discovery date.
Rows and columns mean the same thing.
All the elements were known when the table was made.
